old-light.template:
Every ray of sunlight
begins as a prisoner.
Absorbed. Re-emitted. Over and over.
Each bounce sends it somewhere random.
Then rising plasma carries it up.
Then it breaks free.
You only see the last eight minutes.
Sunlight is old light.
It left the Sun’s core before the first cities were built.
